Rashi on Makkot 23a:10:1.hebrew: אפילו יתירי כח ואפילו חסירי מדע - דאין להקפיד בכך:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:10:1.english: Even exceedingly strong, and even lacking in knowledge - For one need not be particular about this.

Rashi on Makkot 23a:11:1.hebrew: אי אמרת בשלמא דאפילו חסירי מדע - יכולין להעמיד בהן, היינו דאיצטריך כו' למזרז:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:11:1.english: If you say, granted, that even those lacking knowledge - may be appointed [as the attendant], that is why it was necessary etc. to urge [him]:

Rashi on Makkot 23a:12:1.english: That he strikes a great blow - That it is permitted to strike him. Against his will, so it appears to Rabbi; and Rabbi received [it] in another version: This is the text: Our Rabbis taught: Both the man and the woman [are exempt if it happened] with feces and not with water, the words of Rabbi Meir. Rabbi Yehuda says: The man with feces and the woman with water. And the Sages say: Both the man and the woman, whether with feces or with water. But it was taught: Rabbi Yehuda says: Both the man and the woman, with feces. Rabbi Yitzchak said: This that Rabbi Yehuda said, "both the man and the woman, with feces," this is what he is saying: The two are equal regarding feces, for once they have soiled themselves with feces they are exempt; but regarding water there is a dispute.

Rashi on Makkot 23a:13:1.english: Few lashes - For example, where they assessed him [as able to receive] fewer lashes than [are given] in a single recitation of the verses [from beginning to end].

Rashi on Makkot 23a:14:1.hebrew: אין לי אלא מכה רבה כו' - רישא דברייתא הכי איתא בסיפרי: אין לי אלא בזמן שמוסיפין על מנין ארבעים, על כל אומד ואומד שאמדוהו בית דין, מנין? ת"ל לא יוסיף, מכל מקום. מכה רבה, אין לי אלא מכה רבה כו'. אין לי דחייב על לא יוסיף אלא בזמן שהכהו מכות הרבה על האומד; מכות מועטות, אפילו שתי מכות או אחת, מנין דאסור להוסיף? ת"ל לא יוסיף — לא יוסיף להכותו על אלה, על מנין האומד:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:14:1.english: I have only a great flogging, etc. - The beginning of the baraita appears thus in the Sifrei: I have only [a prohibition] when they add to the number of forty, beyond each and every estimate that the court estimated; from where [do I derive the prohibition for a lesser addition]? The verse states, "He shall not exceed," in any case. "A great flogging" — I have only a great flogging, etc. [That is,] I have only that one is liable for "he shall not exceed" when he struck him with many lashes beyond the estimate; for a few lashes, even two lashes or one, from where [do I know] that it is forbidden to add? The verse states, "He shall not exceed" — he shall not exceed in striking him beyond these, beyond the number of the estimate.

Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:1.hebrew: קלה - נתקלקל בריעי. ולישנא דקרא נקט, שנאמר ״ונקלה״, לשון זלזול:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:1.english: Debased - He soiled himself with excrement. And [the baraita] used the language of the verse, "and he be debased" (Deuteronomy 25:3), an expression of degradation.

Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:2.hebrew: בין בראשונה בין בשניה - בין קודם שהכהו כלל, בין לאחר שהכהו. והיינו ראשונה: הגבהה ראשונה, שמגביה ידו להכות — אם נתקלקל באותה הגבהה מחמת פחד; או שנתקלקל בהגבהה שניה, דהיינו לאחר שהכהו:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:2.english: Whether during the first or during the second - Whether before he struck him at all, or after he struck him. That is, the "first" is the first raising [of the arm], when he raises his hand to strike — if he soiled himself during that raising out of fear; or if he soiled himself during the second raising, that is, after he had struck him:

Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:3.hebrew: נפסקה הרצועה - אם בהגבהה שניה נפסקה, פוטרין אותו, דהא נקלה באותה הכאה שהכהו. ואם קודם שהכהו נפסקה, כשהרים ידו להכות, אין זו קלה:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:3.english: The strap was severed - If it was severed during the second raising [of the strap], they exempt him, for he was already debased by that blow with which [the court] struck him. But if it was severed before [the court] struck him, when [the flogger] raised his hand to strike, this is not a debasement:

Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:4.hebrew: פוטרין אותו - דנקלה קרינא ביה, דהא קלה:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:17:4.english: They exempt him - For we can apply to him [the term] "debased" (venikla), since he has indeed been debased:

Rashi on Makkot 23a:18:1.hebrew: לכשילקה קלה - פירושו: לכשילקה יקלה. שאמדוהו שאם ילקוהו מיד יתקלקל בריעי — פוטרים, דפן יוסיף ונקלה כתיב, דאין נותנין לו מכה שיקלה עליה מיד. כך שמעתי. אבל אמדוהו שלא יתקלקל עד לאחר המלקות — מלקין אותו:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:18:1.english: When he is flogged he will be debased - Its meaning is: when he is flogged, he will be debased. That is, they assessed that if they flog him immediately, his bowels will become loosened — they exempt him, since “lest he continue… and your brother be debased” is written, meaning that one does not give him a blow through which he will be debased immediately. So I have heard. But if they assessed that he will not become loosened until after the lashes, they flog him:

Rashi on Makkot 23a:18:2.english: Debased at first - Before he received any blow, they flog him thereafter:

Rashi on Makkot 23a:20:1.hebrew: על אחת כמה וכמה שתנתן לו נפשו - דמדה טובה מרובה ממדת פורענות אחד מחמש מאות. דבמדת פורענות כתיב (שמות כ׳:ה׳) פוקד עון אבות על בנים על שלשים ועל רבעים, ובמדה טובה כתיב (שם) עושה חסד לאלפים, ומתרגמינן לאלפין דרי. ארבעה דורות כנגד אלפים דורות, היינו אחד מחמש מאות. מיעוט לאלפים אינו פחות משני אלפים, וכל שכן אם כפשוטו, דמשמע אלפים עד סוף כל הדורות:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:20:1.english: All the more so that his soul will be given to him - For the measure of good is greater than the measure of punishment by one part in five hundred. For regarding the measure of punishment it is written (Exodus 20:5): "Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, upon the third and upon the fourth [generations]," while regarding the measure of good it is written (ibid.): "And showing kindness to thousands," which we translate [in the Aramaic] as "to thousands of generations." Four generations as against thousands of generations — that is one part in five hundred. The minimum of "thousands" is no fewer than two thousand, and all the more so if it is taken literally, as "thousands" implies until the end of all generations.

Rashi on Makkot 23a:3:1.hebrew: אין חוסמין - אין מגערין בה, שלא תאמר: אי אפשי בו:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:3:1.english: One does not muzzle - One does not rebuke her, so that she will not say, “I do not want him.”

Rashi on Makkot 23a:4:1.hebrew: את המועדות - הכוונה לחולו של מועד:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:4:1.english: The festivals - This refers to the intermediate days of a festival (Chol HaMoed).

Rashi on Makkot 23a:4:2.hebrew: חג המצות תשמור - מפרש בחגיגה (דף יח.): אם בראשון ובשביעי, הרי כבר אמור! הא לא בא להזהיר אלא על חולו של מועד, שאסור בעשיית מלאכה:
Rashi on Makkot 23a:4:2.english: “The festival of Matzot you shall observe” - It is explained in Chagigah (18a): If [it refers] to the first and seventh [days], it has already been stated! Rather, it comes only to warn about the intermediate days of the Festival (Chol HaMoed), on which it is prohibited to perform labor:

Rashi on Makkot 23a:8:1.english: By number - Two portions of wickedness [are struck] from behind him.

Tosafot on Makkot 23a:15:1.hebrew: רבי יהודה אומר (בעינן יתירי כח ו) חסירי מדע - נ"ל דפליג אתנא קמא דאמר אין מעמידין כלל חסירי מדע, דאין מדקדקין בדבר. דבהא טעמא דגמרא אין נכון לכאורה לומר דלרבי יהודה מעמידין דוקא חסירי מדע:
Tosafot on Makkot 23a:15:1.english: Rabbi Yehuda says: (we require those of surplus strength and) those lacking knowledge - It seems to me that he disagrees with the first Tanna, who said that we do not appoint those lacking knowledge at all, because they are not careful about the matter. For with this reasoning of the Gemara, it is apparently not correct to say that according to Rabbi Yehuda we appoint specifically those lacking knowledge:

Tosafot on Makkot 23a:16:1.hebrew: שניהם שוין - ומיהו אשה אף במים:
Tosafot on Makkot 23a:16:1.english: Both are equal - But nevertheless, a woman [is exempted] even with water:

Tosafot on Makkot 23a:17:1.hebrew: קלה - כל הנתקלקל בריעי, איש ואשה, משהגביה הרצועה להלקותו בראשונה או בשניה — פוטרין אותו ואין מכין אותו כלל. אבל הדין של "נפסקה" דוקא כי נפסקה בשניה, שהרי שלקה אחת, ולא שנפסקה בראשון קודם שלקה כלל:
Tosafot on Makkot 23a:17:1.english: "Debased" - Anyone who is debased with excrement, man or woman, from the moment [the court] raised the strap to flog him, whether during the first [lash] or during the second — they exempt him and do not flog him at all. But [the law of] "was severed" applies specifically when it was severed during the second [lash], [since] he had been flogged once, and not when it was severed during the first, before he was flogged at all:
